sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Lack of concentration; impossible to study;
despondent; desire to be with people. Irritable.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Frontal headache, worse over left eye, in
the evening, better by short sleep.

Gastric. — Tongue coated, foul taste. Salty taste to
all cereals. Belching. Appetite increased. Light, yel-
low, narrow, very offensive stool.
